report.status_line: Nominal operations with 4 days to mission end; crew investigating low water flow; remaining water volume unknown since refill.

concerns.title: Low habitat water flow
concerns.detail: The commander reported that water flow in the habitat is very low and under investigation. Total water remaining is unknown following the static tank refill 2 days ago on 2015-01-17. The static tank level was measured at 20 cm from the top today, dropping about 7 cm/day from 13 cm on 2015-01-18. Estimated draw since refill is 169.68 L at the FMARS reference rate (12.12 L/person/day) or 35 L at NASA minimum (2.5 L/person/day) for the 7-person crew.

concerns.title: ATV 2 starting issue during EVA
concerns.detail: The crew reported difficulty starting ATV 2 during the EVA, which was resolved by switching the fuel cock to the reserve (RES) position.

crew_actions: Provide a new total water volume estimate, as remaining water is unknown following the 2015-01-17 static tank refill.
Continue investigating the cause of low water flow in the habitat plumbing.
Check fuel levels and verify fuel cock positions on ATV 2 prior to subsequent EVAs.
Review habitat storage procedures following guidance from Mission Support.
report.message_to_earth: Overall habitat status is nominal with 4 days remaining in the mission, though low water flow is under investigation. On 2015-01-19, the commander reported very low water flow, while static tank depth reached 20 cm from the top, dropping about 7 cm/day. Total water volume remaining is unknown following the static tank refill 2 days ago on 2015-01-17. The crew is troubleshooting plumbing flow and resolved an EVA ATV 2 starting issue by switching to reserve fuel. Propane is nominal at 35% with 24.5 days remaining, and diesel is nominal at 60% with 28 days remaining. No decisions are required from Earth at this time. The next update will be sent tomorrow.
